# Approve -> dispatch -> receive (WS2B)

*Generated by `npm run rehearse:dispatch`. Do not edit by hand.*

Run 2026-09-12T14:19:31.305Z against `http://localhost:3000`, in a real browser.

| | |
|---|---|
| Order | CHC Bhagalpur-02 (Bhagalpur) -> PHC Purnia-01 (Purnia) |
| Item | Anti-Rabies Vaccine (cell culture) |
| Planned | 14 vials |
| Approval re-scored both ends in | 16 ms |
| Receiver, PROJECTED at the full quantity | P(out) 100% -> 2% |
| Dispatched | 14 vials (donor 69 -> 55) |
| Received | 11 vials |
| Variance | 3 vials short on arrival |
| Receiver, ACTUAL | 0 -> 11, P(out) 100% -> 17% |

The last two rows are the point. The plan said the receiver would reach 2%; it reached 17%, because
the risk recovered by what ARRIVED and not by what was sent. A system that could not
represent that gap would be describing a supply chain nobody works in.
